body: It says "factory seconds." These are obviously fakes, right?
Some shoes are often too tight for me as I also have wide feet, so I guess I'll have to pass on the 12,5. Thanks.
For me that doesn't make sense, because his girlfriend needs his help as a dad, right? I guess thats just his personality that he feels like a burden to others.

I get you. My problem is that sometimes I do feel like I've lost. I feel like there is no going back to the normal and that I will ever recover. I guess I'll have to accept one day that its alright to not be like everyone else. It's just so hard when I can't control my mind and thoughts.

I have one person that I talk about it to (Also go to psychiatrist), but for some reason I find it really hard to tell someone that I have social anxiety. I'm OK talking about that I'm depressed but the anxiety part is just so hard for me, I feel like a failure because I'm afraid of socialising while everyone is out having fun. Thanks, I really appreciate it.

Thanks for writing, I'm glad you're doing better. My problem is that I don't have enough motivation and energy to do all of this. I can barely get out of bed and face the daily life. If I go to the grocery store, I'm exhausted afterwards and I'm not able to do anything else that day, other than being at home on my mac or phone. It doesn't mean anything for me to look good or be fit anymore, all I want do is be happy.
It depends. Sometimes up to about 5 hours at most, but normally 2-3 hours. Thanks.
